files.rationale: Standalone checked two-int32 Node-API callback used only to measure scalar native-call boundary overhead across compatible JavaScript runtimes; it is not linked into Sage.js.
Standalone two-int32 CPython FASTCALL and legacy VARARGS extension used only as a matched native-call boundary reference; it is not linked into Sage.js.
Benchmark-local adaptation of node-gyp's MIT-licensed Windows delay-load hook so the same stable Node-API addon can be hosted by Node, Bun, and Deno without binding eagerly to node.exe.
Standalone checked uint32 modular arithmetic callbacks used only to measure scalar, fused, batched, and borrowed-buffer Node-API costs; they are not linked into Sage.js.
Standalone dependency-chained and packed uint32 modular arithmetic benchmark compiled to a minimal host-neutral Wasm module; it is not linked into Sage.js.
Benchmark-local adaptation of node-gyp's MIT-licensed delay-load hook so the finite-field Node-API reference can be hosted by Node, Bun, and Deno on Windows.
Standalone CUDA feasibility and crossover benchmark for packed quadratic-twist weighted sums; it is not linked into Sage.js and includes host transfer and result download in the GPU timing.
Standalone performance harness for the bounded exact genus-3 Jacobian progression search; it is not linked into Sage.js.
Standalone packed genus-2 smalljac timing and exact-stream checksum baseline; it is not linked into Sage.js.

Standalone C-to-Wasm feasibility target for the reviewed bounded modular character scan; compiled only by the optimizer evidence harness, not linked into Sage.js or selected as a production mathematical implementation.

Standalone no-allocation C-to-Wasm microbenchmark that separates internal arithmetic from synchronous Wasm-to-JavaScript objective callback cost; it is not linked into Sage.js or used as a mathematical implementation.

Qualification-only ASAN/UBSAN/LSAN harness for the pinned upstream cminpack lmdif/lmder components, including callback failure propagation; it is compiled only by the release evidence collector and is never linked into or shipped with Sage.js.

Qualification-only ASAN/UBSAN/LSAN harness for the pinned upstream NLopt component closure. Release evidence compiles the selected Nelder-Mead-only path and its cancellation behavior; the guarded COBYLA path is excluded after source-bound sanitizer failure. The harness is never linked into or shipped with Sage.js.
Standalone upstream-source portability oracle for the generic rforest remainder-forest kernel; it is not linked into Sage.js.
Standalone handwritten-C oracle copied from p1.c for the source-transparent Heilbronn compiler pilot.
Standalone GMP ceiling for the lexical live-exact vector addmul witness; it is compiled only by the benchmark and is not linked into Sage.js.

Standalone six-case timing and exact-lattice witness for the direct number-field order resource. It is compiled only by the Unix cross-oracle benchmark and is not linked into Sage.js or exposed as a runtime boundary.

Standalone exact-payload and sanitizer lifecycle witness for the fused field-analysis resource. It is compiled only by focused tests and benchmarks and is not linked into Sage.js or exposed as a runtime boundary.

Linux-only qualification adapter for authenticated PARI 2.17.4 algorithm-stage, prepared-field, and public-call controls. It is compiled into a disposable oracle process and is never linked into or shipped with Sage.js.

Qualification-only Rust-to-FLINT adapter for exact normal forms, retained fraction-free solves, and Arb regulator/root-enclosure operations. Fixed-width values cross through exact fmpz conversions on Unix and wasm32 rather than target slong narrowing. The mathematical kernels remain in pinned FLINT/Arb; this feature-gated adapter is not linked into the Sage.js product path, and a distinct ABI review is required before any native Windows route.

Linux-only untimed authority producer for one pinned pristine PARI 2.17.4 row-20 bnfinit flag-one call. It emits only compact correctness evidence from a disposable helper process and is never linked into Sage.js.

Linux-only untimed authority producer for one manifest-selected pristine PARI 2.17.4 development-field bnfinit flag-one call. It emits compact correctness evidence from a disposable helper process and is never linked into Sage.js.
Linux-only benchmark adapter for the pinned PARI 2.17.4 prepared-nf bnfinit flag-zero reference. It links PARI only in a disposable helper process and is never linked into Sage.js.
Linux-only reusable benchmark helper for pinned PARI 2.17.4 prepared-nf bnfinit flag-zero comparisons. It is compiled into disposable measurement processes and is never linked into Sage.js.

Linux-only timing adapter for the pinned PARI 2.17.4 row-14 prepared-nf bnfinit flag-zero reference. It links PARI only in a disposable benchmark process, keeps nfinit preparation and serialization outside the timed kernel, and is never linked into Sage.js.

Linux-only timing adapter for the pinned PARI 2.17.4 row-0 prepared-nf bnfinit flag-zero reference. It links PARI only in a disposable benchmark process, keeps nfinit preparation outside the timed kernel, and is never linked into Sage.js.

Linux-only disposable driver for the pinned PARI 2.17.4 stage-clock derivative and its pristine control. It serializes benchmark authority and timing evidence, is not a Sage.js mathematical implementation, and is never linked into Sage.js.
Matched handwritten-C reference for a source-transparent compiler benchmark.
Cross-runtime reference implementation; it is not linked into Sage.js.
Narrow host-neutral façade over FFLAS/FFPACK packed small-prime multiplication and canonical RREF, with complete shape and residue validation and transactional generated copyback.

Host-neutral generated owned-resource ABI over M4RI dense GF(2) matrices, with checked dimensions and empty shapes, canonical logical row-word and SagePack transfer, deterministic lifecycle accounting, and direct resource-to-resource linear algebra.
Qualification-only host-neutral adapter over cminpack's upstream MINPACK-2 MGH functions; it is compiled into an independent oracle reactor and is never shipped as the production solver.

Bounded callback, total evaluation-budget, allocation, cancellation, and status ABI over the pinned cminpack lmdif/lmder implementation; mathematical iteration policy stays in authenticated upstream source, allocations are operation-scoped, and Sage.js independently validates returned residuals.

Bounded packed callback, force-stop, allocation, status, and linear-memory ABI over the pinned MIT NLopt Nelder-Mead source; NLopt owns the algorithm, automatic selection is disabled, and Sage.js independently applies contradiction checks before any heuristic public success. COBYLA is excluded after source-bound UBSAN exposed unresolved upstream pointer-provenance undefined behavior.
Narrow Wasm ABI over FLINT factorization and primality operations.
Bounded Wasm32 buffer and status adapter over the shared Arb and Acb analytic batch core; all mathematical policy remains in the host-neutral core.

Bounded generation-tagged Wasm32 MPFR/Acb resources plus a finite expression transport. The GK21 and bisection loops are a reviewed compiler-limitation exception because the synchronous reactor cannot invoke host callbacks and source-transparent kernels cannot yet own MPFR/Acb resources.
Fixed bounded Wasm32 buffers adapt caller-owned canonical packets to the host-neutral FLINT multivariate resultant and msolve Groebner cores; no mathematical algorithm is implemented in this file.
Flat generation-tagged Wasm32 resource adapter over the host-neutral FLINT QQbar core, with copied arbitrary-integer and certified enclosure transport.
Flat bounded Wasm32 transport adapter over the authoritative host-neutral elliptic L-series core, with separate arbitrary-precision and explicitly binary64 plot schemas.
Fixed-width Wasm32 ABI, status codes, and resource limits for the shared elliptic L-series value and plotting core.
Bounded copied-input Wasm32 adapter over the pinned genus-one ffpoly/smalljac coefficient generator; exact Euler recurrence and bad-reduction fallback remain explicit and differentially tested.
Fixed-width lifecycle, mode, status, and copied-buffer ABI for elliptic coefficient generation in the production Wasm reactor.
Bounded stateless Wasm32 projection of mature FLINT Dirichlet group decomposition metadata used to materialize public group objects above the ABI.
Wasm adapter over the host-neutral P1 and modular-symbol core.
Bounded Wasm32 buffer ownership and status adapter over the shared fixed-width number-field residue-factor batch core.
WASI compatibility symbols required by the browser build.
Narrow BSD-licensed FLINT/WASI fenv macro and mkstemp declaration shim used only by the pinned direct FLINT cross-build.
Minimal C compile/link/run probe for the pinned direct WASI SDK; it has no production consumer.
Minimal C++ compile/link/run probe for the pinned direct WASI SDK; it has no production consumer.
Standalone raw Preview 1 conformance probe compiled and run against the Sage.js host and an independent standards-oriented host; it is not linked into production.

Host-neutral generated owned-resource ABI over FLINT exact univariate polynomials and callee-owned factorizations, including immutable sealing, retained-size accounting, structural arithmetic, exact evaluation, stable serialization, and variable-size factor results computed once.

Host-neutral generated owned-resource ABI over arbitrary-prime FLINT polynomial contexts and values, with immutable sealing, exact modulus guards, callee-owned arithmetic and aggregate results, one host-boundary payload transfer for each factor or roots result, stable serialization, and deterministic lifecycle accounting.
Host-neutral generated owned-resource ABI over FLINT dense integer matrices, with physical retained-size accounting, structural arithmetic, exact algorithms, formatting, and stable serialization.

Generic context-owned exact workspace primitive for Native Kernel C5b. It preallocates bounded GMP residents and arithmetic scratch once, authenticates shape/specification/generation before each synchronous mutable borrow, reference-counts owner and lexical lease lifetimes, rejects overlapping or stale borrows, and publishes no mathematical proof state. Ordinary typed Python remains the algorithm and dynamic fallback.

Host-neutral Zassenhaus Round-2 p-maximal-order kernel over FLINT storage, paired with an ordinary-Python fallback and differential oracle. Independent coprime-prime jobs use a bounded monotone pthread queue with fixed caller-order output slots; forced-static, pthread-failure, and non-pthread sequential paths remain exact lifecycle oracles. Its optional proof-carrying mode performs a distinct terminal radical and multiplier-minor derivation inside each independent local worker before publishing that worker's immutable slot: p-adic workers rerun the theorem from their certified modulo-p-squared tensor with fresh workspaces and generic row selection, while non-p-adic workers use their live exact table. It does not replay enlargement.

Direct sealed fmpz-polynomial to canonical HNF order resource. It owns compact transfer and lifecycle adaptation while reusing the audited Round-2 mathematical kernel; optional terminal-proof slots are transferred only for a complete construction, and arbitrary-size unsupported local work is returned intact to the strict fallback.

One-crossing immutable field-analysis resource over FLINT storage. It packs a proof-carrying construction result that binds the nested canonical order, sealed polynomial, full caller-prime tuple, local canonical bases, and independently rederived terminal radicals and full-rank multiplier minors. This representation boundary is a measured compiler exception: the source-transparent degree-64 O(n^4) replay took 18.185s, while a FLINT resource producer took 2.356s for three primes; the later full 12-prime standalone verifier still cost 3.776s and was removed from the production FFI. Construction-carried verification measured 2.399s total on vector429, including a 0.237s native proof delta and 0.299s current projection. The ordinary source remains the external mathematical oracle, immediate generated-call authentication is prefix-only and source-bound, and Windows retains an exact sequential fallback.

Focused test-only witness for deterministic construction-carried terminal-proof equivalence across bounded parallel, forced-one-worker, and pthread-creation fallback paths, plus injected terminal-check failure and sanitizer lifecycle coverage; it is never linked into Sage.js.
Standalone cross-platform lifecycle and exact-lattice witness for the direct number-field order resource boundary; it is compiled only by the focused test and is not linked into Sage.js.

Standalone exact, corruption, forced-fallback, and sanitizer witness for independent coprime-prime Round-2 construction and lattice merging; it is compiled only by focused tests and is not linked into Sage.js.

Host-neutral generated owned-resource ABI over one-column FLINT integer and rational matrices, providing distinct exact-vector type tags, variable-size entry ownership, canonical byte streams, structural arithmetic, dot products, and deterministic lifecycle accounting. Its perfect-power adapter repeatedly applies FLINT's mature extraction primitive into a two-entry owned vector; ordinary Python independently checks the exact identity and terminal primitive root before using that result.
Host-neutral packed-slice adapter to mature FLINT polynomial algorithms for declaration-generated kernels.
Host-neutral owned-resource ABI over variable-size FLINT rational matrices for declaration-generated kernels and replaceable host adapters.

Host-neutral generated owned-resource ABI over FLINT word-prime matrices, with checked bulk ingress, deterministic lifecycle accounting, direct resource-to-resource arithmetic and elimination, formatting, and canonical width-8 serialization.

Host-neutral generated owned-resource ABI over word-characteristic FLINT extension contexts, elements, and univariate polynomials, with bulk canonical power-basis coordinates, exact context identity, thread-affine shared ownership, structural arithmetic, and deterministic lifecycle accounting.

Host-neutral representation boundary over FLINT fq_nmod_mpoly: canonical modulus ingress, retained contexts, checked sparse coordinates and exponent widths, copied SJFM/SJFF output, and direct calls to FLINT arithmetic, gcd, resultant and factorization. Input/output limits do not claim bounds on FLINT intermediate memory or elapsed time. Public dispatch and lazy production qualification remain separate gates.
Standalone finite-extension polynomial representation, exact foreign-algorithm, malformed-input, and retained-context witness for native and Wasm compilation; not linked into the Sage.js runtime.
Host-neutral fixed-width ABI for exact genus-3 Mumford arithmetic, bounded progression search, cancellation, and recheckable element-order certificates.

Host-neutral fixed-scratch FLINT fmpq-polynomial workspace for source-transparent rational Cantor kernels; it supplies representation and lifetime primitives while the mathematical group law remains ordinary typed Python.
Host-neutral fixed-width ABI for batched genus-2 local factors and supported smalljac Jacobian group invariants.
Host-neutral fixed-width ABI for batched genus-2/3 rforest Hasse--Witt residues with explicit modular normalization and row statuses.
Shared Sage.js native mathematical ABI declarations.
Standalone LLP64 regression oracle for exact fixed-width GMP adapters used by the portable smalljac build.
Portable exact 64-bit ffpoly arithmetic primitives for GCC, Clang, Apple Silicon, and native Windows clang-cl.
Fixed-width GMP conversion layer that prevents LLP64 truncation in transformed smalljac and ffpoly sources.
Standalone exact trace-stream harness used to compare portable smalljac with the established optimized implementation.
Independent randomized oracle for portable multiply, carry, division, and bit-scan primitives.
Large Node-API adapter containing both boundary code and locally implemented helpers.
Shared declarations for the FLINT Node-API addon registration boundary.
Node-API bridge to FLINT algebraic-number operations.
Declarations for the algebraic-number bridge.
Packed boundary to established FLINT characteristic-polynomial algorithms.
Declarations for the characteristic-polynomial bridge.
Sage.js-owned exact cyclotomic row-reduction algorithm over FLINT storage.
Declarations for cyclotomic row reduction.
Combines Node-API adaptation, FLINT/Arb calls, and locally assembled character operations.
Declarations for Dirichlet-character native operations.
Narrow Node-API adapter around the pinned, patched eclib 2-descent source closure; mathematical algorithms remain attributable to upstream eclib and use FLINT storage.
Internal addon declaration for the eclib rank-data boundary.
Host-neutral Arb/Acb ABI for the canonical completed elliptic L-function central jet and moderate-complex values, with explicit analytic-tail diagnostics and ordinary-Python differential fallbacks.

Combines compact Arb/Acb completed-L-function kernels with exact coefficient conversion and batched Node-API adapters for elliptic and genus-2/3 hyperelliptic central jets and moderate-complex values.
Internal addon declarations for the batched elliptic and hyperelliptic central-jet and moderate-complex L-function boundaries.
Node-API bridge to FLINT finite extension-field operations.
Declarations for finite extension-field operations.
Node-API bridge to MPFR/MPC/Arb floating-point operations.
Declarations for native floating-point operations.
Owned Node-API Arb and Acb resources providing certified outward-rounded interval operations through the established FLINT library.
Internal declarations for the certified Arb and Acb interval resource boundary.

Bounded exact genus-3 Cantor arithmetic and congruence-strided BSGS certification kernel; handwritten C is retained because the object-heavy Python fallback is not source-transparently compilable and the measured fallback is the pipeline bottleneck.
Node-API packing adapter for bounded genus-3 progression searches and exact certificates; Python independently rechecks every certificate with the ordinary group law.
Declarations for the private genus-3 Jacobian Node-API callbacks.

Bounded packed adapter that evaluates hyperelliptic edge quadrature and complete real-period refinements with mature Arb/Acb ball arithmetic; ordinary mpmath panels and pinned PARI periods provide independent differential oracles.
Declarations for the bounded hyperelliptic Arb/Acb edge and complete real-period adapters.
Narrow validated adapter from smalljac callbacks to bounded packed local-factor and Jacobian-invariant buffers, with an exact ordinary-Python fallback.
Checked Harvey--Sutherland curve-transition construction around the pinned rforest matrix-product library, returning only modular Hasse--Witt residues.
Large matrix adapter containing FLINT calls, storage management, and locally implemented algorithms.
Declarations for native matrix operations.
Host-neutral bounded packed bridge to mature Arb and Acb analytic batch operations shared by native and WebAssembly adapters.
Fixed-width packed ABI and resource limits for the shared Arb and Acb analytic batch core.
Host-neutral generation-tagged resource core over mature FLINT QQbar operations, exact roots, comparisons, serialization, and certified Arb enclosures.
Fixed-width lifecycle, copied-buffer, and exact algebraic-number ABI shared by Node and WebAssembly host adapters.
Host-neutral bounded canonical packet bridge to mature FLINT fmpz_mpoly resultant computation, with no host callbacks or retained pointers.
Fixed-width packet schema, status codes, and resource limits for the shared multivariate resultant boundary.
Host-neutral bounded parser and serializer for one-crossing msolve prime-field and rational Groebner packets, with explicit allocation and output limits.
Versioned fixed-width packed ABI, status codes, and resource limits shared by native tests and the WebAssembly msolve adapter.
Narrow status-returning ownership and process-containment bridge around pinned msolve F4 and modular rational exports.
Owned result structures and status-only host-neutral ABI for the pinned msolve integration.
Host-neutral Sage.js implementation of weight-2 modular-symbol algorithms adapted from PARI.
Host-neutral modular-symbol core ABI shared by Node and Wasm.
Node-API bridge to FLINT multivariate polynomial operations.
Declarations for multivariate polynomial operations.
